approved_text: Does there exist a positive integer n such that n is 2-full (every prime dividing n divides it at least squared) and n+1 is 3-full (every prime dividing n+1 divides it at least cubed)?

source_docstrings: Are there any $2$-full $n$ such that $n+1$ is $3$-full?
